major_concerns: Design relies on human intent-oracle labeling though capability_manifest disallows human scientific labour (conflict with run constraints).
Deterministic verifiers proposed may not represent production diversity (vendor/proprietary features missing).
Synthetic/vendor-mapping realism risk — public mappings may omit important proprietary semantics.
Oracle intent labels are subjective; inter-rater noise may reduce effective power.
Single hosted LLM limits generality; results may not generalize across models/vendors.
required_design_repairs: Replace disallowed human-oracle steps with a preregistered, reproducible adjudication alternative (e.g., LLM-based adjudicator calibrated on an existing public human-labeled dataset) or explicitly justify and provide publicly available human-labeled data consistent with capability limits.
Preregister exact verifier implementations and versions; include at least two open-source verifiers or clearly justify representativeness.
Document and publish synthetic vendor mappings, anonymization, and limitations; include sensitivity analysis for proprietary-feature gaps.
Predefine inter-rater/agreement procedures and minimum sample sizes; preregister power analysis and retry policy.

major_concerns: Design filters to verifier-passing outputs only, reducing sample size and inflating uncertainty if not preregistered with adequate power.
Adjudication plan requires two independent human labelers (conflicts with human_scientific_labour_allowed:false).
Ambiguity and false-premise injection procedures are underspecified and may bias results.
Use of single LLM and fixed prompt may conflate model artifacts with task phenomena.
required_design_repairs: Replace human adjudicators with a reproducible LLM-based adjudication pipeline calibrated against a publicly available labeled corpus, or otherwise ensure labels are public and allowable under manifest constraints.
Preregister ambiguity/false-premise generation procedures, include objective ambiguity scoring rules, and run power analysis to ensure adequate verifier-passing sample size.
Include multi-model checks or sensitivity runs, or justify single-model choice and limit claims accordingly.
Publish all prompts, seeds, and retained verifier logs to enable repeatability.

major_concerns: Operational-impact cost model is necessarily simplified and may drive fragile conclusions if not stress-tested.
Seeded faults may not capture the full diversity of real operational errors.
Detection-latency measurement sensitive to infrastructure timing variability.
required_design_repairs: Preregister the cost-model mapping and include sensitivity analyses over plausible cost parameters.
Openly publish the seeded-fault taxonomy and example cases; justify representativeness or bound claims to the seeded taxonomy.
Specify and preregister synchronized timing methodology for latency metrics and include repeated measures to estimate infrastructure variance.
Release metric-computation code and example datasets to ensure reproducibility.

major_concerns: Design depends on a calibrated proxy reviewer derived from a small human-labeled calibration set — conflicts with no-human-labour constraint unless calibration data are public and permissible.
Estimated reviewer-time proxies are approximate and may not reflect real operator workload.
Proxy reviewer calibration bias can meaningfully change strategy rankings.
Explainability-assisted gating may conflate rationale quality with reviewer heuristics; measurement needs specification.
required_design_repairs: Either use a publicly available human-labeled calibration dataset consistent with capability limits or fully specify a reproducible LLM-based proxy-reviewer calibration procedure and make calibration data/code public.
Preregister reviewer-time estimation method and validate it against at least one external public benchmark or sensitivity range.
Define and preregister how explainability artifacts are generated and evaluated; include ablation showing effect of rationale quality on gating outcomes.
Limit claims to proxy-evaluated outcomes and explicitly state external-validity caveats.
